messages:
Jess Park: ok team — tiny life update: Henry + Mira are getting married!! :tada: :heart: do we want to do a small office celebration this Friday at lunch? quick poll: cake vs empanadas vs nothing (kidding).
Henry Lu: omg yes!!! we would love that. no presents pls, just come and eat my face 🙂
Mira Solano: a small cake sounds perfect. thanks everyone for the love ❤️
Oliver G.: congrats both!! I can bring savory things (samosas or empanadas). Friday works for me.
Jess Park: sweet — thinking 12:30 in the kitchen. i’ll order a small cake and paper plates. who can bring something? reply with emoji: :cake: = i'll bring dessert, :bread: = savory, :taco: = sides/snacks, :thumbsup: = just show up
Henry Lu: :thumbsup: (we're buying the cake, pls no pressure)
Mira Solano: :taco:
Oliver G.: :bread:
Opsbot: calendar event created: "Henry + Mira: Tiny Office Celebration" Fri 12:30–1:00 (added channel #random). Link: https://calendar.company/evt/2141000000
Jess Park: also — quick logistical note: if anyone needs dietary restrictions, dm me. Mira is gluten-free so nothing with wheat pls 🙏
Oliver G.: noted, will do GF samosas :)
Jess Park: final q — want to do a 2min shoutout during lunch (few stories, congrats) or keep it low-key? react with :speech_balloon: for shoutouts, :zzz: to keep it chill
Henry Lu: :speech_balloon: (i promise not to cry)
Mira Solano: :speech_balloon:
Oliver G.: :speech_balloon:
Jess Park: amazing. thanks y’all. this makes my week. ❤️
Opsbot: reminder set for event 24h before.
